title: PiPiBot Host Protocol v2 Canonical Contract
description: Single source of truth for shared TypeScript (@pipibot/protocol) and Swift (PipiBotKit) enums and structured payloads. Clean-room MIT implementation inspired by the architectural concepts of simplexai-labs/linger (see root NOTICE and LICENSE).
x-pipibot-upstream-inspiration: simplexai-labs/linger (clean-room architectural inspiration; zero verbatim code copied)

SchedulerPriority.description: Strict 7-tier execution priority order (highest to lowest). Approval reviews and interactive foreground work take precedence over background work.

TeamCollaborationPattern.description: Structured multi-bot collaboration patterns for Wave 3 team.md protocol.

WikiEntityCategory.description: Personal-oriented entity taxonomy for PiPiBot Personal Wiki (Wave 2 #01).

WikiSearchScope.description: Dual-channel Personal Wiki search scope (originals chunks + facts vs wiki summaries).

BotMemoryLifecycleStage.description: Per-Bot isolated experiential memory entry lifecycle (Wave 2 #02).

ProactiveSourceKind.description: Wave 2 (#03) first-batch macOS native signal sources for proactive awareness and Prepare.

ProactiveActionDecision.description: Structured proactive evaluation outcome including read-only Prepare pre-briefing.

ProactiveFeedbackSignal.description: Explicit or implicit user response to a proactive nudge or prepared briefing used for Clue -> Rule dreaming.

DelegationTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle state for Wave 3 (#05) Meta / AlterEgo in-chat background delegated tasks.

DynamicBotProposalAction.description: Wave 3 (#06) action kind when an orchestrator dynamically proposes inviting or creating a missing role Bot.

DynamicBotProposalStatus.description: Approval status of a Wave 3 (#06) dynamic Bot invitation or creation proposal.

TrackingItemStatus.description: Wave 3 (#11) lifecycle status for daily Pocket Note extracted tracking items.

ModelSourceMode.description: Wave 4 (#07) unified active model source mode for a computer.

LocalInferenceEngineKind.description: Wave 4 (#07) supported local inference engine backends including MIT PolyStrata and Apple Silicon native fallbacks.

ModelSelfTestStatus.description: Wave 4 (#07) real QA verification status before a local model counts as ready.

VoiceInteractionMode.description: Wave 4 (#10) personal daily voice interaction modes (non-meeting).

VoiceSessionState.description: Wave 4 (#10) lifecycle state of an active daily voice session including echo-gated barge-in.

VoiceEngineProvider.description: Wave 4 (#10) on-device-first and optional BYOK cloud STT/TTS providers.

VoicePrivacyPolicy.description: Wave 4 (#10) strict routing policy controlling whether voice audio may ever leave the device.

ComputerUsePhase.description: Wave 5 (#09) Computer Use dual-phase target surface: Phase A signed-in Chrome vs Phase B macOS Accessibility desktop.

BrowserSeatMode.description: Wave 5 (#09) Phase A Chrome profile isolation strategy (per-agent seat in signed-in Chrome or isolated profile).

ComputerUseActionType.description: Wave 5 (#09) structured browser/desktop input primitive; arbitrary page-script execution is intentionally omitted.

ComputerUseLaneKind.description: Wave 5 (#09) concurrency lane taxonomy: one global desktop screen lane and independent per-agent browser lanes.

ComputerUseLaneState.description: Wave 5 (#09) live state of a Computer Use concurrency lane including human-focus yield and unknown-outcome lock.

WriteAheadJournalStatus.description: Wave 5 (#09) Write-Ahead Journal entry status preventing duplicate clicks and uncertain replays.

BoardThreadKind.description: Board primitive thread classification inspired by Vercel Board coordination semantics.

BoardTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a Board task thread supporting atomic claims, dependency blocking, and human review.

BoardActorKind.description: Identity category for a participant posting to or claiming work on the Board.

BoardEventKind.description: Structured live activity event kind emitted by PipiBoardEngine for SSE and inspect streams.

SubscriptionProviderKind.description: Paid CLI subscription or Mainland China / third-party OpenAI-compatible provider that can be stacked across multiple accounts/keys to expand quota.

SubscriptionAccountStatus.description: Live operational status of a stacked subscription account inside the Account Pool.

SubscriptionPoolStrategy.description: Account selection & failover strategy when multiple paid subscription accounts are stacked.

TeammateRuntimeMode.description: Execution residency for an AI teammate: local machine, 24/7 cloud host, or hybrid failover.

CloudBrowserStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a teammate's isolated persistent cloud/local browser container.
